validation_ack.reason: Two private placements in 2021 (586,205,939 shares in May and 948,979,590 on 10-13 Dec 2021) lifted FY-end shares to 10,487,132,568, but FY2021 basic loss per share Rp-12.90 is on a weighted average of 9,228,483 thousand shares (FS2021 Note 38, PDF p. 146, https://victoriabank.co.id/uploads/2025-03-14_2022-04-28_LKT%202021.pdf): -12.90 x 9,228.5m = Rp-119.0bn = reported loss. Real weighted-average effect.

Two rights issues in 2022 (PMHMETD VI +2,553,461,919 shares listed 31 Aug 2022, PMHMETD VII +2,807,640,227 allotted 28 Dec 2022): FY2022 basic EPS Rp19.17 is on a weighted average of 11,795,945 thousand shares (FS2022 Note 39, PDF p. 149, https://victoriabank.co.id/uploads/2023-03-31_LKT%202022.pdf): 19.17 x 11,795.9m = Rp226.1bn = reported profit; FY-end shares 15,848,234,714.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document was downloaded directly from victoriabank.co.id/uploads/ on 2026-11-03 with curl and a browser User-Agent (no bot protection, no archive copy needed; idx.co.id not used). The two KSEI rights-schedule notices came straight from web.ksei.co.id (cross-check only). The 2023-2026 OJK published reports are single-page Illustrator PDFs with no text layer for the tables: they were rendered at 250 dpi (pdftoppm) and read visually; the monthly OJK reports and all audited FS/ARs have text layers.

ENTITY / BASIS: FY2019-FY2021 statements are consolidated with PT Bank Victoria Syariah (BVS, 99.99%). On 22 Dec 2022 the bank sold 80% of BVS to its parent PT Victoria Investama Tbk (common-control transaction at nominal Rp288bn, loss Rp968m to APIC; FS2022 Note 50 PDF p. 191): BVS is consolidated in the FY2022 income statement until 22 Dec 2022, but the 31 Dec 2022 balance sheet is the bank alone with BVS as a 19.81% equity-accounted associate. FY2023-FY2025 statements are stand-alone (no subsidiaries); they are the whole reporting entity and are stored as basis 'consolidated' (validator convention, as for BBYB/MEGA). On 5 Jun 2025 the remaining 19.81% was sold to PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk for Rp322.5bn (gain Rp100.66bn in FY2025 other operating income; FS2025 PDF p. 93) - BTN uses BVS for its sharia spin-off. Group perimeter therefore changes at end-2022: loans and deposits FY2021->FY2022 are not like-for-like (FY2021 includes BVS financing/DPK).
UNITS: all audited FS are in Rp thousand (divided by 1e6, full precision kept); OJK published reports in Rp million (divided by 1e3).

DEPOSITS DEFINITION: FY2019-FY2021 deposits = customer deposits + temporary syirkah customer deposits of BVS (loans include BVS sharia financing). Customer deposits excluding syirkah: 2019 21,791.637; 2020 18,331.429; 2021 18,084.872 IDR bn. From FY2022 there is no syirkah fund. Deposits from other banks are excluded throughout.

RATIOS: all FY ratios are bank-only (the AR tables are footnoted 'Merupakan angka PT Bank Victoria International Tbk (Entitas Induk saja)') and identical to the OJK published-report ratios; ROE is Tier-1 based (OJK), ROA pre-tax (OJK). CIR is printed from FY2021 (AR2022 MD&A) - FY2020 null. Not disclosed anywhere (ARs, FS, Pubex 2023/2024/2025 decks): cost of credit, NPL coverage, loan at risk (FY) - null. NIM 2024: 2.21 (highlights, published report) vs 2.22 (MD&A, Pubex) - 2.21 stored.

LOSS YEARS ARE REAL: FY2019 -13.8bn, FY2020 -252.2bn, FY2021 -119.1bn (heavy provisions, NIM 0.82% in 2020). Ratios such as ROE -12.74 / BOPO 112.09 (2020) and ROE -6.54 / BOPO 104.94 (2021) are as printed. FY2025 profit 131.7bn includes the one-off Rp100.66bn gain on the BVS sale (core profit much lower).

DIVIDENDS: no cash dividend was paid from FY2019-FY2025 profit (loss years 2019-2021; AGMS 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 allocated FY2022-FY2025 profit to the general reserve and retained earnings). payout_ratio is stored as 0 with the AGMS/FS-note source for each year. The IR share-information page (https://victoriabank.co.id/page/tinjauan-ekonomi/informasi-saham, 'Riwayat Dividen') shows the last cash dividends for FY2009 and FY2013. dividends[] is empty.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026: no split, reverse split or bonus issue (AR2025 share-listing chronology PDF pp. 99-100, printed pp. 97-98; IR share-listing table). Two rights issues, both in 2022 (PMHMETD VI ex 9 Aug 2022 100:67 @ Rp150; PMHMETD VII ex 14 Dec 2022 100:38 @ Rp150 with free Series VII warrants) - recorded in corporate_actions. Not recorded (no schema type): private placements without pre-emptive rights (PMTHMETD) of 280,898,877 shares @ Rp356 (listed 29 May 2019), 586,205,939 @ Rp160 (May 2021) and 948,979,590 @ Rp196 (listed 13 Dec 2021); Series VII warrant exercises 2023-2025 (2,571,184,114 shares; most in Q2 2025). fy.2019.year_end_price (84) is stored as an extra anchor although no rights/bonus ex-date falls before 2020-12-31.

FY2025 EPS: the bank divides FY2025 profit by 18,419,419 thousand shares (= year-end count) although 2.57bn warrant shares were issued during 2025 (most in Q2) - printed EPS 7.15 kept as is; EPS x FY-end shares therefore matches profit.

INTERIM 9M2026: from the OJK quarterly published report of 30 Sep 2026 ('Publikasi September 2026 - Updated'), except equity, which comes from the OJK monthly report of the same date because the quarterly report adds Rp1,199,988m of apparently subordinated bonds to equity ('Ekuitas Lainnya'; total equity 5,636,989 vs 4,437,001 in the monthly report and CET1 4,072,714). No 9M2026 interim FS was posted on the bank's site (the IR site posts only half-year interim FS). A REVIEWER should re-check equity when the 9M2026 interim FS appears on IDX.

KBMI: KBMI 1 (core capital Rp4.0tn at end-2025; AR2025 benchmarks against KBMI 1). Controlling shareholder PT Victoria Investama Tbk (60.17% at 30 Sep 2026) and ultimate controller Suzanna Tanojo (6.32% direct).
